title: Create a crisp, clean infographic storyboard poster for THE DOMINO’S PIZZA…
content:
Create a crisp, clean infographic storyboard poster for THE DOMINO’S PIZZA MAKER. Wide 16:9 layout, white background, black borders, bold black typography, premium Pixar 3D stylized rendering, bright commercial food colors — rich melted cheese yellow, vivid tomato red sauce, golden crusts, glossy pepperoni, fresh basil green, stainless steel silver kitchen equipment, warm pizza oven glow.

Top header: •THE DOMINO’S PIZZA MAKER •TOTAL VIDEO TIME: 12 SECONDS •8 SHOTS · CHEESY · FAST · SATISFYING •Legend icons: ACTION, HEAT, TIME HINT, INGREDIENT

Same Pixar-style young Domino’s worker throughout — blue-and-red Domino’s uniform, black cap, energetic smile, modern pizza kitchen, prep counters, dough station, glowing pizza ovens, bright commercial lighting. Fast-paced but clean and satisfying.

8 panels:

1.THE OPENER — Wide cinematic shot. Busy Domino’s kitchen alive with movement, pizza boxes stacked nearby, ovens glowing in the background, prep stations full of toppings. Worker stands center frame tossing dough confidently with a grin.

2.THE DOUGH — Extreme close-up. Fresh pizza dough slapped onto a floured prep counter, flour bursting into the air dramatically, dough stretching outward in slow motion under bright kitchen lights.

3.THE SAUCE — Overhead locked shot. Worker spreading vivid red tomato sauce in perfect circles using a metal ladle, glossy sauce spiraling evenly across the dough.

4.THE CHEESE — Medium shot. Giant handfuls of shredded mozzarella raining down over the pizza, cheese bouncing naturally while the worker moves quickly and confidently.

5.THE TOPPINGS — Close-up. Pepperoni slices placed rapidly across bubbling cheese, colorful vegetables and herbs added while steam from nearby ovens drifts through frame.

6.THE OVEN — Side-angle cinematic shot. Pizza sliding into a glowing conveyor pizza oven, intense orange oven light reflecting across stainless steel surfaces.

7.THE SLICE — Beauty overhead shot. Fresh pizza pulled from the oven, perfectly sliced, melted cheese stretching dramatically between slices, steam rising heavily.

8.THE TASTE — Tight emotional shot. Worker lifting a hot cheesy slice, taking one huge bite, melted cheese stretching while eyes close slowly in satisfaction. Warm oven glow behind him.

Footer: •VIDEO FLOW: 8 shots × ~1.5s = 12 seconds. Dough to delivery. •CAMERA TIPS: wide opener, extreme close-up on dough slam, overhead sauce spiral, medium cheese rain shot, close-up toppings placement, side-angle oven shot, overhead pizza beauty shot, tight emotional bite shot •LIGHT & STYLE: warm oven lighting, glossy cheese textures, vivid tomato reds, golden crusts, bright Domino’s commercial colors, Pixar-style expressive realism throughout •PIZZA NOTES: one worker, one pizza journey, stretchy cheese and steam everywhere. Fast, cheesy, and impossible not to crave.

7. LA REBANADA — Toma aérea de belleza. Pizza fresca sacada del horno, perfectamente rebanada, queso derretido estirándose dramáticamente entre las rebanadas, el vapor elevándose intensamente.

8. EL SABOR — Toma emocional cerrada. Trabajador levantando una rebanada caliente y con queso, dando un gran mordisco, el queso derretido estirándose mientras los ojos se cierran lentamente en satisfacción. Resplandor cálido del horno detrás de él.

トップヘッダー: •THE DOMINO’S PIZZA MAKER •総動画時間: 12秒 •8ショット · チーズたっぷり · 速い · 満足感 •レジェンドアイコン: アクション、熱、時間のヒント、材料

3.ソース — オーバーヘッドロックショット。従業員が金属製のレードルを使って鮮やかな赤いトマトソースを完璧な円を描いて広げ、光沢のあるソースが均等に生地に広がる。

4.チーズ — ミディアムショット。巨大な手いっぱいのシュレッドモッツァレラがピザの上に降り注ぎ、チーズが自然に跳ね返りながら、従業員が素早く自信を持って動く。

5.トッピング — クローズアップ。ペパロニスライスが泡立つチーズの上に素早く配置され、カラフルな野菜やハーブが追加され、近くのオーブンからの蒸気がフレームを通り抜ける。

6.オーブン — サイドアングルのシネマティックショット。ピザが輝くコンベアピザオーブンに滑り込み、強烈なオレンジのオーブンライトがステンレススチールの表面に反射する。

7.スライス — ビューティーオーバーヘッドショット。オーブンから取り出された新鮮なピザが完璧にスライスされ、溶けたチーズがスライス間で劇的に伸び、蒸気が重く立ち上る。

8.味わい — タイトな感情的ショット。従業員が熱々のチーズたっぷりのスライスを持ち上げ、大きな一口をかじり、溶けたチーズが伸びる間に目をゆっくり閉じて満足感を味わう。背後には温かいオーブンの輝き。

2. 도우 — 극단적인 클로즈업. 신선한 피자 도우가 밀가루가 뿌려진 준비 카운터에 놓이며, 밀가루가 극적으로 공중으로 터져 나가고, 도우가 밝은 주방 조명 아래에서 슬로우 모션으로 바깥쪽으로 늘어납니다.

5. 토핑 — 클로즈업. 페퍼로니 슬라이스가 끓는 치즈 위에 빠르게 놓이고, 컬러풀한 야채와 허브가 추가되며, 근처 오븐에서 나오는 증기가 프레임을 통과합니다.

7. 슬라이스 — 아름다운 오버헤드 샷. 신선한 피자가 오븐에서 꺼내져 완벽하게 슬라이스되며, 녹은 치즈가 슬라이스 사이에서 극적으로 늘어나고, 증기가 무겁게 올라옵니다.

8. 맛 — 타이트한 감정 샷. 직원이 뜨거운 치즈 슬라이스를 들어 한 입 크게 베어 물며, 녹은 치즈가 늘어나고 눈이 천천히 만족스럽게 감깁니다. 그 뒤로 따뜻한 오븐의 빛이 비칩니다.
